##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Tuesday, 25 August 2026 at 4:15am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

High pressure centred over Scandinavia.


##Wind##

East 4 or 5, increasing 5 or 6 late evening until later in the night.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Occasional rain overnight.


##Visibility##

Mostly good, falling moderate in rain later.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

East 4 or 5, occasionally 6 in the north of the area at first, decreasing 3 or 4, occasionally 2 for a time in the afternoon and evening. Then occasionally increasing 5 overnight.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming slight.


##Weather##

Rain or showers at times.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in rain or showers.
